steps: Create an X developer account and a project with an app, and pick a paid API access tier (the API itself is billed by X; ADR section 8)
In the app's user authentication settings enable OAuth 2.0 and add the callback URL below
Copy the OAuth 2.0 Client ID and Client Secret from Keys and Tokens
Store them: switchboard vault set x_client_id and switchboard vault set x_client_secret
Register them: switchboard authconfig add x --client-id-ref x_client_id --client-secret-ref x_client_secret
notes: Observed 2026-10-23 (X OAuth 2.0 docs): authorize at https://x.com/i/oauth2/authorize with PKCE, token at POST https://api.x.com/2/oauth2/token, revoke at POST https://api.x.com/2/oauth2/revoke. A confidential client sends HTTP Basic with the client id and secret; a public client sends client_id in the body. Scopes are space separated. A refresh token is issued only with the offline.access scope; an access token otherwise lasts two hours; the authorization code lives 30 seconds. The callback must match the app setting exactly.

UNVERIFIED: whether refresh tokens rotate (the docs do not say; this file assumes they do, and the engine persists any new refresh token either way), and whether the console accepts an http loopback callback.
Observed (X users/me reference): identity is GET https://api.x.com/2/users/me?user.fields=profile_image_url, readable with tweet.read and users.read.
ADR section 8 (Observed there): analytics returns 403 below the Enterprise tier. Current API price: UNVERIFIED.
Only the scopes verified in the docs above plus tweet.write, like.read and like.write are listed; the full X scope list was not fetched.
